ledger.note: 1858: the infobox end. The almamate continued under French protection: Mahmadu Lamine captured Boulibani in February 1886 and killed the French-aligned almamy Omar Penda on 16 July 1886; the French burned the town on 26 December 1886 (Mahmadu Lamine page) and "the last almamy, chosen by the French, died in 1902".

notes:
Bundu, additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Pages: Bundu (state), Mahmadu Lamine (the disambiguation Bundu and Boundou did not load).

The end is the problem: the infobox says 1858, the body describes the 1885-87 jihad "after which French control was effectively complete" and a last almamy who died in 1902; no page dates the protectorate. 1858 is the infobox's and is followed at confidence 2; the french-africa ledger should add the protectorate over Bundu with its own date. The Bundu page has Umar Tall taking over in the 1851 civil war with Bundu aristocrats' support: a Tukulor vassal period 1851-1857 is plausible but undated; the tukulor-empire dossier should say so if its page does. Bambuk's eastern land is "eventually" taken, with no year, and the Khasso relation is not on the page. Mahmadu Lamine captured Boulibani in February 1886 and was captured and died in December 1887 (9 or 12 December: the Mahmadu Lamine page's lead and infobox disagree).
